reproduction: Run the actual verified source16 private client on gm_flatgrass with the existing native fallen-body population.
Proceed through ordinary walking toward the actual Redcard after the StrengthPress preview setup.
Observe native console NextBot[85][lod_hostile] error at sv_magnum_aim_state.lua:271: attempt to call method GetActiveWeapon (a nil value).

The existing FallenHeroes production ranged path calls shared RollPlayerWeapon for its copied firearm. The Aim decorator invokes a Player-only method after the shared base contract was already produced.

In the strengthened real production FallenHeroes harness, remove the incorrectly inherited fixture NPC GetActiveWeapon method and load actual Magnum/Aim wrappers. Exact original source fails at the same271 line.

Guarding only that first access exposes the same invalid assumption at323 in the global native EntityFireBullets marker-cleanup hook, reached by FallenHeroes FireWeapon. This adjacent failure is statically reproduced, not a second native observation.
expected: Independent fallen actors retain canonical copied firearm contracts and execute native fire without Player-only API calls. Real players keep existing armed Aim consumption, burst behavior and deferred Magnum marker cleanup.
